Focusing Styles
When assessing the client, it may become clear which behavior change 
would benefit the client most, which would align with the nutrition diag-
nosis step of the NCP. If the practitioner chooses the focus of the session, 
then it is considered a counselor-directed session.
However, when incorporating motivational interviewing into the ses-

she would like to work on, thereby making the nutritional diagnosis and
